top_signals.title: The U.S. Power Play in Iraq That Moscow and Beijing Didn’t See Coming
top_signals.summary: As Russia remains occupied with its war in Ukraine, Iran focuses on defending its territory against U.S. and Israeli attacks, and China maintains its involvement in both conflicts under the bar that would trigger direct conflict with America, Washington is leveraging its position in Iraq. These efforts by the U.S. and its allies have taken on further urgency as Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi announced last week that the country plans to raise oil production to between 8 million barrels per day (bpd) and 10 million bpd within six years -- so…

top_signals.title: Fusion Firm Gets Major Monetary Boost
top_signals.summary: Commonwealth Fusion Systems has raised around $4 billion in order to work toward commercializing fusion energy, that's about 30% of the total capital raised by the fusion industry to-date, according to CFS. In explaining on Bloomberg Businessweek what fusion is, the company's CEO Bob Mumgaard says the goal "is to build a machine that can make this reaction go at very vigorous amounts of energy at an industrial scale." (Source: Bloomberg)
